name: Tonari no Oyako Pudding
source:
A love style adventure game in which you can play perverted pranks such as having a bath together with the girl next door whom you yearn for, just like your older brother. Welcoming in a critical turning point in your life, the graduation, and among meeting various other people, just how are you going to change from these experiences? A full, explosive line-up of married women, childhood friends and small children!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007843.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款爱情风格的冒险游戏，你可以像你的哥哥一样，和你向往的邻家女孩一起洗澡等变态恶作剧。迎接你人生中的一个关键转折点，毕业，在遇到各种各样的人的过程中，你将如何从这些经历中改变？已婚妇女、青梅竹马、小孩子的阵容齐全，爆炸性十足！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007843.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
